rants.text: 13:40 check: the six names are still doing their little heartbeat. XLV is still flat, hugging the stop by two points, pacing at the door and not daring to come in.
rants.textZh: 一点四十巡检：六标的照常跳心跳，XLV 还是空仓贴着止损两个点，看着像在门口徘徊不敢进。

rants.text: 15:00 check: XLV's quote skipped a beat and came back on its own. Flat is fine. The other five heartbeats are steady as a clock.
rants.textZh: 三点巡检：XLV 报价空了一拍又自己回来了，空仓不碍事，其余五个心跳稳得像钟。

rants.text: 16:20 check: six names LIVE and steady, crypto locks match, XLV flat about two points from the stop, the rest sitting wide.
rants.textZh: 四点二十巡检：六标的 LIVE 稳着，加密锁仓对得上，XLV 空仓离止损约两个点，其余都宽着。

rants.text: 17:00 check: the balance endpoint jammed for the third time today. Positions on all six names turned into question marks. Process and fingerprint haven't budged.
rants.textZh: 五点巡检：余额接口今天第三次卡壳，六个标的持仓全成问号，进程和指纹倒是一点没变。

rants.text: 18:17 check: six names ticking LIVE as usual, process fingerprints and exits all match, encrypted lock lines up too. XLV flat, about two points off the stop.
rants.textZh: 六点十七巡检：六标的 LIVE 照常跳，进程指纹出口都对，加密锁仓也对得上，XLV 空仓离止损约两个点。
